name: WhiteTone Soft And Smooth Face Cream 25gm
description:
WhiteTone Soft and Smooth Face Cream 25gm (Made in India)

Nourish and brighten your skin with WhiteTone Soft and Smooth Face Cream, specially formulated to keep your skin healthy, hydrated, and radiant.

Key Benefits:

Deep Nourishment: Supplies essential nutrients for healthier skin.

Hydration: Keeps skin soft, smooth, and well-moisturized.

Brightening Effect: Helps make skin look brighter and glowing.

Clear Pores: Supports clearer, healthier-looking skin.

Brand Origin: India | Net Weight: 25gm

Perfect for daily use to achieve soft, glowing, and nourished skin.
